entries.source_note: MOF English-edition text of Announcement No. 4 and the official republication chain for Nos. 5/6/7/8/10 and No. 6 (2026)
entries.note: Together with WA-POL-M-050 this row is a two-part split of the same announcement; the two must not be added together into a 34% rate in force.

entries.product: All imports originating in the United States — suspended portion of Announcement 2025 No. 4
entries.stacks_on: Additional to applicable tariff rate (not currently levied)
entries.status_detail: Suspension chain: No. 7 for 90 days -> No. 8 for 90 days -> No. 10 for one year -> No. 6 (2026) for two months (to 10 Jan 2027); if not renewed at expiry, the 24 percentage points resume collection, subject to inspection and re-determination
entries.source_note: Same source chain as WA-POL-M-049
entries.note: effective_from takes the effective date of Announcement No. 7's reduction, 14 May 2025; effective_to is the current suspension expiry date.

entries.product: Grid-connection operation management for dispatch-controlled generators, new-type storage and adjustable loads
entries.status_detail: Superior rules for grid-connection dispatch agreements, grid-related testing, AGC/AVC and assessment management
entries.source_note: NEA government-information-disclosure original-text link and subsequent citing documents

entries.product: Ancillary services management: active/reactive power balance, emergency and restoration services
entries.status_detail: Active-power balance services include frequency regulation, peak shaving, reserves, inertia and ramping; together with the 2025 market basic rules (WA-POL-M-055) these form the two layers of management measures and market rules
entries.source_note: NEA government-information-disclosure original-text link

entries.product: New-type energy storage grid connection and dispatch (dispatch-called vs self-use classes)
entries.status_detail: After grid connection, all grid-related tests must be completed within the prescribed time; new-type storage within dispatch scope must connect to AGC/AVC and automatically regulate active/reactive power per dispatch instructions; in emergencies it accepts unified direct dispatch
entries.source_note: NEA text (republished by the Henan regulatory office)
entries.note: effective_to is the expiry of the document's five-year validity period.

entries.product: Power market operation basic rules (all market members incl. storage, virtual power plants, load aggregators)
entries.status_detail: Transaction types include energy, ancillary services and capacity trading; the 2005 Basic Rules for Power Market Operation were repealed at the same time
entries.source_note: NDRC government-information-disclosure original text

entries.product: Ancillary services market basic rules: peak shaving, frequency regulation, reserves, ramping
entries.status_detail: Cost-sharing and price-formation principle: 'whoever provides, profits; whoever benefits, bears'; providers must be observable, measurable, adjustable and controllable
entries.source_note: NDRC original text

entries.product: Distributed photovoltaic development, construction and grid access management
entries.status_detail: Grid enterprises provide access services fairly and without discrimination; publishable distribution-network capacity is released quarterly with early warning; new projects must be observable, measurable, adjustable and controllable; four project classes (natural-person household / non-natural-person household / general commercial-industrial / large commercial-industrial) and three feed-in modes
entries.source_note: NEA original text and policy interpretation
entries.note: effective_to is the expiry of the document's five-year validity period.

entries.product: New renewable generation projects — prohibition of mandatory storage allocation as precondition
entries.status_detail: Mandatory energy-storage allocation must not be made a precondition for the approval, grid connection or feed-in of new renewable projects; renewable generation output in principle enters the power market in full and is priced through trading
entries.source_note: NDRC original text
entries.note: This row extracts only the clauses directly related to grid connection; the price mechanism itself (stock/increment settlement mechanisms) is deferred to a later batch.

entries.product: Single-user green-power direct-connection projects (grid-connected and off-grid types)
entries.status_detail: Key parameters: for grid-connected projects, annual self-generated and self-consumed electricity >=60% of total available generation and >=30% of total consumption (>=35% before 2030); annual feed-in in principle <=20% (set at provincial level); no reverse feed-in during consumption-constrained periods
entries.source_note: NDRC original text; cross-checked against the 2026 multi-user document and the NEA press Q&A

entries.product: Multi-user green-power direct-connection projects (industrial parks, zero-carbon parks, incremental distribution networks)
entries.status_detail: Key parameters consistent with the single-user framework: source sized to load; annual self-consumption >=60% of available generation and >=30% of total consumption (>=35% before 2030); grid-connected annual feed-in in principle <=20%
entries.source_note: NDRC original text and press Q&A
entries.note: Extends WA-DOC-2025-0108; does not replace the single-user document.
